sdk.source: npm registry (inspected tarball; API read from shipped src/dist, not invented)

feature: RetroPick Private Strategy Vault — Earn hub Vault tab

requirements.webauthnPrfDerivedSecret: SDK derives a non-extractable AES-256-GCM key from the passkey PRF output (HKDF-SHA-256, fixed info) — all cryptography is the SDK's, no custom crypto
requirements.stableRelyingPartyId: rpFromLocation() = current hostname (localhost in dev, deployment host in prod)
requirements.realUserVerification: every create/unlock/save runs a real WebAuthn ceremony (no mocked credentials)
requirements.encryptedStorage: localStorage holds only the v1 PasskeySecretVault JSON (credential metadata + prfSalt + nonce + ciphertext)
requirements.noPlaintextAtRest: verified by e2e assertion on stored value
requirements.noPersistedKeys: keys are derived per-ceremony and never stored (SDK zeroes PRF buffers; wrapper zeroes plaintext buffers on lock)
requirements.saltAndNonceManagement: SDK-generated fresh 32-byte salt per vault/save, 12-byte GCM nonce internal to the SDK
requirements.schemaVersioning: VAULT_SCHEMA_VERSION=1 plaintext envelope {v, entries[]}; unknown/future versions rejected fail-closed
requirements.prfUnavailableHandled: MeraError PRF_UNAVAILABLE mapped to actionable user text (implemented; automated ceremony-path evidence limited by headless browser without authenticator — see README)
requirements.lostPasskeyDisclosure: visible disclosure: no synced copy ⇒ unrecoverable
requirements.crossDeviceRecovery: export vault JSON + import on another device with the same synced passkey (manual path; honest limitation recorded)

nonWalletUse: Vault stores strategy theses, draft prediction markets, watchlists, agent risk budgets, market-making configs — independent of any trading-wallet signing; unlocking grants zero spending authority (disclosed in UI)
innovation: Confidential Trader Intent: users can store a bounded instruction/strategy privately; the vault never becomes a signing authority
verdict: LOCAL_TEST_VERIFIED + BROWSER_E2E_VERIFIED (failure states); full PRF happy-path ceremony requires a real platform authenticator — operator manual evidence pending (see README)
